title: panicum maximum var. confine
intro: Panicum maximum var. confine, commonly known as Elephant Grass, is a tropical grass species native to the Americas. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, treating fever, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Elephant Grass include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit strong antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
